calibration_notes: Acoustic pilot: waveform 0 triangle, 1 saw; native pulse travel approximately 6.75%-53.25% duty at A3, square2=.93 (H2 -58.97 dB before fine tune). NoiseType0 white (-0.19 dB/oct), 1 pink (-3.20 dB/oct). VCO2 coarse min/mid/max 54.953/219.798/879.252 Hz with centred fine tune. Fine2 calibrated to VCO1 220.350 Hz using measured slope; fine1 remains centre. Both sweep timing and 22-second uninterrupted note checked. Repeated saw pitch differed below .00001 Hz and steady level .011 dB. Output fixed -13.98 dB; loudest pilot peak .2263. First samples align with note onset, no fixed latency adjustment. Initial patch Biggu Reibu; macro inputs zero, destinations retained. Reference tracking and actual intervals are reported after final capture; hardware behaviour remains unmeasured.
